name: Joram
description: A hornless elf boy bearing the mark of the Raven, born in Strongroot, who takes a copper sphere from Amur.

description_citations.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Joram uses the copper sphere from Amur to grow horns.
timeline.quote: Joram uses the copper sphere (the artifact) to grow horns

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Mark of the Raven, by Jess Lebow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Mullenix touches the sphere, black tendrils sprout and the canker consumes the councilors, including Tekla, Joram's mother.
timeline.quote: Black tendrils sprout from it, and the councilors, including Tekla, Joram's mother, are consumed by the merciless canker disease

timeline.summary: Amur leads the black poplar army, destroying the safehold and slaying every elf but Joram.
timeline.quote: It is destroyed and all elves present are slain by the poplars, save for Joram
